definitions.quantiles: Nearest rank over finite nonnegative samples; missing is not zero.
definitions.frame_telemetry: Native WebSocket received frames, unique session_id/generation/frame_id; receipt in Node monotonic measurement window. Values are server snapshots and may repeat previous ACK observations in distinct frames.
definitions.publish_to_ack_upper_bound_ms: Server monotonic publication-to-client-ACK round trip upper bound; not one-way GPU latency.
definitions.browser_receive_to_paint_ms: Application browser receive through committed DOM and two rAF opportunities; frame and visualization cohorts stay separate.
definitions.observer_duration_ms: Backend observer duration reported in native frame telemetry, not client drawing time.
definitions.draw_ms: Unique painted pane/view IDs observed in the actual chart DOM; JavaScript Canvas submission duration, not GPU completion. Missing attributes are explicitly unavailable.
definitions.raf_interval_ms: Consecutive real requestAnimationFrame callback timestamps wholly inside the browser measurement interval.
definitions.input_issue_to_focus_2raf_ms: Node time immediately before an actual Playwright click through visible active-element confirmation and two rAF callbacks; includes automation and actionability waits.
definitions.input_browser_focus_to_2raf_ms: Browser focus event to two rAF opportunities; reported separately, never substituted for full interaction latency.
definitions.long_task_ms: PerformanceObserver longtask durations whose starts fall in the browser measurement interval.
definitions.query_requests: Actual visualization/ladder requests issued within the Node measurement window; response status, completed body, aborted transport, failed transport, and unresolved are separate. pane_id is copied only when present in the native payload.

limitations: Descriptive local sample only: no certification, SLA, significance claim, real-market or live-capacity inference.
Real synthetic demo data and real HTTP/WebSocket traffic; no data injection, routing, fake socket, wallet, collector or real orders.
Fresh browser context does not evict OS caches. Headless rendering, observers, automation and concurrent host load affect timings.
Node and browser clocks have different origins and are never subtracted. No GPU/pixel completion is measured.
Frame telemetry snapshots may repeat a last-ACK value across unique frame IDs; these are snapshot distributions, not independent ACK event distributions.
DOM draw sampling sees only observed painted view IDs; intermediate views can be missed. Both visible chart panes contribute when present.
Interaction focus is DOM/style evidence, not pixel-level focus-ring verification. Clicking Seek delivery does not change its value or source.
CDP duration deltas are renderer counters, not whole-machine CPU usage; heap delta is retained heap, not allocation volume.
Before/current dist comparisons use the same backend implementation, not the original historical backend; compare sequential runs at the same viewport/duration.
